entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not working for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best assist, could you tell me a little more? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken, I just don't like it! The strap is uncomfortable and the screen is too small. I want my money back.
Okay, thank you for clarifying that for me. I've just pulled up your account details and can see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 25 days ago. Is that correct?
I guess? It's been a few weeks. What does that matter?
I understand. Unfortunately, because it has been over 20 days since delivery, it is now too late to process a return for this item.
WHAT?! Are you serious? Too late? That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard! I want to speak to your manager. Now.

I understand your frustration, but I can assure you the manager would provide the same information. Our return policy for wearable electronics like the Pulse is very strict due to health and safety standards.
Health and safety? I barely even wore it! This is a scam. I am going to write a review on every single website and tell them how you treat your customers!

Sir, I do apologize for the inconvenience, but this is a firm company policy. After 20 days, we cannot accept these items back. It becomes a matter of hygiene and sanitation, as we cannot resell a device that has been in a customer's possession for that length of time.
I don't care about your policy! It's a bad policy! You're just trying to steal my money. Get me your supervisor!
I am the final point of contact for this type of request. The decision is based on our established safety protocols and the timeline. Again, I'm sorry, but it is simply too late to accept the return.
Unbelievable. Just... unbelievable. Fine. You've lost a customer for life. What a joke.
I understand your decision. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
